```{r set}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(cmdstanr)
library(mgcv)
```

## Parameters

```{r pars}
n <- 30
# forest
y_0 <- 331
alpha <- 4.5
beta <- 0.99
sigma <- 2.5
# climate
sigma_c <- 2
gamma <- 0.5
```

## Climate

```{r clim}
set.seed(42)
clim <- rnorm(n, (1:n)/n, sigma_c)
tibble(
  ysd = 1:n,
  clim = clim
) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(ysd, clim, fill = clim)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c()
```

## Forest

```{r forest}
set.seed(42)
y <- vector(length = n)
y[1] <- y_0
for(i in 2:n)
  y[i] <- rnorm(1, alpha + beta * y[i-1] + gamma * clim[i], sigma)
data <- tibble(
  ysd = 1:n,
  y = y,
  clim = clim
)
ggplot(data, aes(ysd, y)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(col = clim)) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_viridis_c()
```

# AR1

```{r ar1}
model <- cmdstan_model("models/ar.stan")
model$print()
```


```{r fit}
fit <- model$sample(data = list(n = n, y = y, clim = clim), 
                    show_messages = FALSE)
fit$summary("y_p") %>% 
  mutate(ysd = 1:n()) %>% 
  left_join(data, by = "ysd") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(ysd)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q5, ymax  = q95), alpha = .3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = median)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = y, col = clim)) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_viridis_c()
```

```{r post}
fit$summary(c("alpha", "beta", "sigma", "gamma"))
```

# GAM

```{r gam}
tibble(
  ysd = 1:n,
  y = y,
  clim = clim,
  y_p = gam(y ~ s(ysd, k = 5) + clim, data = data) %>% 
    predict()
) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(ysd)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = y_p)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = y, col = clim)) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_viridis_c()
```

```{r gamsum}
gam(y ~ s(ysd, k = 5) + clim, data = data) %>% 
  summary()
```
